units.source_text: 据说西阵的手织机是很难连传三代的。

en.t: It is said that the handlooms of Nishijin are very difficult to pass down for three generations in succession.

units.source_text: 因为手织机属于工艺一类，即使父辈是优秀的织匠，从某种意义上说，就是有高超技术的人，也不见得能传给儿子。

en.t: Because handloom weaving belongs to the realm of craft, even if the father is an excellent weaver, in a sense a person with superb skill, that skill is not necessarily something he can pass on to his son.

units.source_text: 儿子不能因为父亲的技术高超，自己就可以偷懒；

en.t: The son cannot simply slack off because his father's skill is outstanding;

units.source_text: 有时即使勤奋学习，还不一定能学到手。

en.t: and sometimes, even if he studies diligently, he still may not be able to master it.
